assertions.evidence: subscriptionReactivation.ts computes the one-year check in code via `isMoreThanOneYearOld(startedAt, now)`, using `setFullYear(... + 1)` and `now > anniversary`, before any model call.
The decide request sets `state: { cancellation_reason: reason }` and contains no startedAt or now dates.
The question `suggests_return` has `type: "noul"` and asks whether the customer may return; code applies `answer.noul >= RETURN_PROBABILITY_THRESHOLD` (0.65).
